# HexPiece 2.6.7

Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **Less lag turning Haki on.** Blackening your skin read your skin back from the graphics card every time Haki came on, and again
  1, 2 and 5 seconds later (slow on phone graphics). The blackened copy is now kept while Haki is off, so only the first time in a
  world pays for it.
- 2.6.6's fix for the blade flickering is in here too.
